In the UK dietary reference values (see p.1925) have been published for copper.1 Although an esti- mated average requirement (EAR) could not be derived a refer- ence nutrient intake (RNI) of 1.2 mg (19 micromoles) daily was set for adults; RNIs of lower values were also specified for in- fants and children.1 The Expert Group on Vitamins and Minerals2 have established a safe upper level (SUL) for copper of 160 micrograms/kg daily.
